sampling.selection: Exclude already-rendered Miami and Cambridge and empty entries from the existing cache of *-samples.json. Sort the remaining labels by SHA-256 of UTF-8 seed, slash, label. Use the first label and its middle frame. This pool conditions on coverage.

camera.lensNote: EXIF contained no camera intrinsics. FOV and camera height are assumed. Pitch was estimated from the source vanishing point before rendering.

validation.renderer: Metal Forward Mobile, Godot 4.7.2, Apple A18 Pro

medianForegroundRoadROI.interpretation: Same-frame displayed pixel values. Lighting, exposure and date differ. Physical reflectance is unknown.

observations: Both images show the straight multilane road and vegetation along the right side.
The 2017 photograph shows a white right edge stripe, pavement arrows, overhead utilities, gravel access and a boat display. These details are absent in this render.
The photographed roadside has a dense low vegetation band and variable crown heights. The render has separated crowns, exposed trunks and wide gaps at eye height.
The 2017 survey date limits claims about the current street.

reproduce: Use a separate test project with a 960x720 viewport. Run godot --resolution 960x720 --path game -- --reference 25.08706 -80.449145 223.2 80 /absolute/path/output.jpg -12.5 0 --complete-reference. External map layers may update.
